name: Zafran Hair Mask 120gm
description:
Zafran Hair Mask 120g

Revitalize and nourish your hair with Zafran Hair Mask, specially formulated to give shiny, silky, and softer hair while protecting against damage.

Key Benefits:

Adds Moisture: Deeply hydrates hair for a healthy, smooth texture.

Reduces Hair Breakage: Strengthens hair and minimizes damage.

Controls Frizz: Helps maintain sleek and manageable hair.

Healthier Scalp: Promotes scalp wellness and reduces environmental or product-related damage.

Volume: 120g | Made in Pakistan

Perfect for achieving softer, shinier, and more resilient hair with regular use.
